'''2009 Bespin Regionals Max Mattese DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Max Mattese]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Poli-Space
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
